The Quezon City local government announced the temporary full closure of a portion of Cambridge Street in Cubao to vehicular traffic from June 1 until some time in December 2027 for the construction of the QCitizen Homes - Cambridge housing project.

The closure will span from Cambridge Street at the corner of K-9th Street in West Kamias to Ermin Garcia Street in Barangay E. Rodriguez.
